# One deposit, two customers, and one of the portions is a prepayment: Alpha
# is paying ahead (so their portion carries `lot_owner:` and sits in a credit
# lot of their own), while Beta's portion is there to settle Beta's invoice
# and is still loose.
#
# Nothing about Alpha's credit says anything about the split beside it. A
# credit lot on a shared deposit is not evidence about its neighbour — only
# the other half of a *divided* credit is, and that half says so on itself.
customer "C-TWO-A"
	name: "Alpha"
	currency: CAD

customer "C-TWO-B"
	name: "Beta"
	currency: CAD

2026-05-15 * "Deposit from Alpha and Beta"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 220.00 CAD
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -120.00 CAD
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -100.00 CAD
		lot_owner: "customer:C-TWO-A"
